Now let me also add a check to prevent the email verification screen from showing if the user is already verified. The issue might be that the EmailVerificationScreen is being rendered even when the user is verified. Let me add a check in the EmailVerificationScreen itself:


```javascript
import React, { useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  StatusBar,
  Alert,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BORDER_RADIUS, hp, wp } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const EmailVerificationScreen = ({ navigation, email }) => {
  const { sendEmailVerification, isEmailVerified, signOut, forceEmailVerified, clearSavedCredentials, user } = useContext(AuthContext);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [verificationSent, setVerificationSent] = useState(false);
  const [checkingVerification, setCheckingVerification] = useState(false);
  const [verificationCompleted, setVerificationCompleted] = useState(false);

  // Check if user is already verified and redirect if so
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const checkIfAlreadyVerified = async () => {
      if (user && user.emailVerified === true) {
        console.log('🔍 User is already verified, redirecting to home');
        // Redirect to home screen
        navigation.navigate('home');
        return;
      }
    };

    checkIfAlreadyVerified();
  }, [user, navigation]);

  // Check if email is verified periodically
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval = null;
    let isChecking = false;

    const checkVerification = async () => {
      if (isChecking || verificationCompleted) return; // Prevent multiple simultaneous checks
      isChecking = true;
      setCheckingVerification(true);
      
      try {
        const verified = await isEmailVerified();
        if (verified && !verificationCompleted) {
          setVerificationCompleted(true);
          
          // Clear the interval immediately to prevent multiple alerts
          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            interval = null;
          }
          
          // Email is verified, redirect to login
          Alert.alert(
            'Email Verified!',
            'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
            [{ 
              text: 'Sign In', 
              onPress: async () => {
                // Sign out and redirect to login
                await signOut();
              }
            }]
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error checking email verification:', error);
      } finally {
        setCheckingVerification(false);
        isChecking = false;
      }
    };

    // Check immediately
    checkVerification();

    // Check every 10 seconds (increased from 5 to reduce frequency)
    interval = setInterval(checkVerification, 10000);

    return () => {
      if (interval) {
        clearInterval(interval);
      }
    };
  }, [isEmailVerified, signOut, verificationCompleted]);

  const handleSendVerification = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await sendEmailVerification();
      if (result.success) {
        setVerificationSent(true);
        Alert.alert(
          'Verification Email Sent',
          'Please check your email and click the verification link to continue.'
        );
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error?.message || 'Failed to send verification email');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Send verification error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to send verification email. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResendVerification = async () => {
    await handleSendVerification();
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Sign Out',
      'Are you sure you want to sign out? You can sign back in after verifying your email.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Sign Out',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            await signOut();
          }
        }
      ]
    );
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor={COLORS.background.primary} />
      
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.backButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Verify Your Email</Text>
        <View style={styles.placeholder} />
      </View>

      {/* Content */}
      <View style={styles.content}>
        {/* Icon */}
        <View style={styles.iconContainer}>
          <MaterialIcons name="email" size={80} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
        </View>

        {/* Title */}
        <Text style={styles.title}>Check Your Email</Text>
        
        {/* Subtitle */}
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          We've sent a verification link to:
        </Text>
        
        {/* Email */}
        <Text style={styles.emailText}>{email}</Text>
        
        {/* Instructions */}
        <View style={styles.instructionsContainer}>
          <Text style={styles.instructionsTitle}>What to do next:</Text>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Check your email inbox</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Click the verification link</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Return to the app</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Status */}
        {checkingVerification && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Checking verification status...</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {verificationSent && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <MaterialIcons name="info" size={20} color={COLORS.blue[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Verification email sent!</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Manual Check Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.checkButton}
          onPress={async () => {
            setCheckingVerification(true);
            try {
              const verified = await isEmailVerified();
              if (verified) {
                setVerificationCompleted(true);
                Alert.alert(
                  'Email Verified!',
                  'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Not Verified', 'Your email is not yet verified. Please check your email and click the verification link.');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to check verification status. Please try again.');
            } finally {
              setCheckingVerification(false);
            }
          }}
          disabled={checkingVerification}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
          <Text style={styles.checkButtonText}>
            {checkingVerification ? 'Checking...' : 'Check Verification Status'}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Force Email Verified Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.orange[50], borderColor: COLORS.orange[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            try {
              const result = await forceEmailVerified();
              if (result.success) {
                Alert.alert(
                  'Debug: Email Marked as Verified',
                  'Email verification status has been manually set to verified. You can now sign in.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Debug Error', result.error || 'Failed to force email verification');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Debug Error', 'Failed to force email verification');
            }
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="bug-report" size={20} color={COLORS.orange[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.orange[600] }]}>
            Debug: Force Email Verified
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Clear All Data Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.red[50], borderColor: COLORS.red[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            Alert.alert(
              'Clear All Data',
              'This will clear all saved data and sign you out. Are you sure?',
              [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { 
                  text: 'Clear All', 
                  style: 'destructive',
                  onPress: async () => {
                    try {
                      await clearSavedCredentials();
                      await signOut();
                      Alert.alert('Data Cleared', 'All data has been cleared. Please restart the app.');
                    } catch (error) {
                      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to clear data');
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            );
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="delete-forever" size={20} color={COLORS.red[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.red[600] }]}>
            Debug: Clear All Data
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Footer */}
      <View style={styles.footer}>
        {!verificationSent ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.primaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleSendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.white} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="send" size={20} color={COLORS.white} />
                <Text style={styles.primaryButtonText}>Send Verification Email</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.secondaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleResendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                <Text style={styles.secondaryButtonText}>Resend Verification</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.continueToLoginButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.continueToLoginButtonText}>Continue to Login</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.signOutButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.signOutButtonText}>Sign Out</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};
```

Now let me also add a loading state to prevent the screen from showing while we're checking the verification status:


```javascript
import React, { useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  StatusBar,
  Alert,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BORDER_RADIUS, hp, wp } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const EmailVerificationScreen = ({ navigation, email }) => {
  const { sendEmailVerification, isEmailVerified, signOut, forceEmailVerified, clearSavedCredentials, user } = useContext(AuthContext);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [verificationSent, setVerificationSent] = useState(false);
  const [checkingVerification, setCheckingVerification] = useState(false);
  const [verificationCompleted, setVerificationCompleted] = useState(false);

  // Check if user is already verified and redirect if so
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const checkIfAlreadyVerified = async () => {
      if (user && user.emailVerified === true) {
        console.log('🔍 User is already verified, redirecting to home');
        // Redirect to home screen
        navigation.navigate('home');
        return;
      }
    };

    checkIfAlreadyVerified();
  }, [user, navigation]);

  // Show loading while checking verification status
  if (!user) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
          <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Checking verification status...</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // Check if email is verified periodically
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval = null;
    let isChecking = false;

    const checkVerification = async () => {
      if (isChecking || verificationCompleted) return; // Prevent multiple simultaneous checks
      isChecking = true;
      setCheckingVerification(true);
      
      try {
        const verified = await isEmailVerified();
        if (verified && !verificationCompleted) {
          setVerificationCompleted(true);
          
          // Clear the interval immediately to prevent multiple alerts
          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            interval = null;
          }
          
          // Email is verified, redirect to login
          Alert.alert(
            'Email Verified!',
            'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
            [{ 
              text: 'Sign In', 
              onPress: async () => {
                // Sign out and redirect to login
                await signOut();
              }
            }]
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error checking email verification:', error);
      } finally {
        setCheckingVerification(false);
        isChecking = false;
      }
    };

    // Check immediately
    checkVerification();

    // Check every 10 seconds (increased from 5 to reduce frequency)
    interval = setInterval(checkVerification, 10000);

    return () => {
      if (interval) {
        clearInterval(interval);
      }
    };
  }, [isEmailVerified, signOut, verificationCompleted]);

  const handleSendVerification = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await sendEmailVerification();
      if (result.success) {
        setVerificationSent(true);
        Alert.alert(
          'Verification Email Sent',
          'Please check your email and click the verification link to continue.'
        );
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error?.message || 'Failed to send verification email');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Send verification error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to send verification email. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResendVerification = async () => {
    await handleSendVerification();
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Sign Out',
      'Are you sure you want to sign out? You can sign back in after verifying your email.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Sign Out',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            await signOut();
          }
        }
      ]
    );
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor={COLORS.background.primary} />
      
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.backButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Verify Your Email</Text>
        <View style={styles.placeholder} />
      </View>

      {/* Content */}
      <View style={styles.content}>
        {/* Icon */}
        <View style={styles.iconContainer}>
          <MaterialIcons name="email" size={80} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
        </View>

        {/* Title */}
        <Text style={styles.title}>Check Your Email</Text>
        
        {/* Subtitle */}
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          We've sent a verification link to:
        </Text>
        
        {/* Email */}
        <Text style={styles.emailText}>{email}</Text>
        
        {/* Instructions */}
        <View style={styles.instructionsContainer}>
          <Text style={styles.instructionsTitle}>What to do next:</Text>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Check your email inbox</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Click the verification link</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Return to the app</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Status */}
        {checkingVerification && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Checking verification status...</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {verificationSent && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <MaterialIcons name="info" size={20} color={COLORS.blue[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Verification email sent!</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Manual Check Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.checkButton}
          onPress={async () => {
            setCheckingVerification(true);
            try {
              const verified = await isEmailVerified();
              if (verified) {
                setVerificationCompleted(true);
                Alert.alert(
                  'Email Verified!',
                  'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Not Verified', 'Your email is not yet verified. Please check your email and click the verification link.');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to check verification status. Please try again.');
            } finally {
              setCheckingVerification(false);
            }
          }}
          disabled={checkingVerification}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
          <Text style={styles.checkButtonText}>
            {checkingVerification ? 'Checking...' : 'Check Verification Status'}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Force Email Verified Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.orange[50], borderColor: COLORS.orange[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            try {
              const result = await forceEmailVerified();
              if (result.success) {
                Alert.alert(
                  'Debug: Email Marked as Verified',
                  'Email verification status has been manually set to verified. You can now sign in.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Debug Error', result.error || 'Failed to force email verification');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Debug Error', 'Failed to force email verification');
            }
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="bug-report" size={20} color={COLORS.orange[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.orange[600] }]}>
            Debug: Force Email Verified
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Clear All Data Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.red[50], borderColor: COLORS.red[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            Alert.alert(
              'Clear All Data',
              'This will clear all saved data and sign you out. Are you sure?',
              [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { 
                  text: 'Clear All', 
                  style: 'destructive',
                  onPress: async () => {
                    try {
                      await clearSavedCredentials();
                      await signOut();
                      Alert.alert('Data Cleared', 'All data has been cleared. Please restart the app.');
                    } catch (error) {
                      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to clear data');
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            );
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="delete-forever" size={20} color={COLORS.red[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.red[600] }]}>
            Debug: Clear All Data
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Footer */}
      <View style={styles.footer}>
        {!verificationSent ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.primaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleSendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.white} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="send" size={20} color={COLORS.white} />
                <Text style={styles.primaryButtonText}>Send Verification Email</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.secondaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleResendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                <Text style={styles.secondaryButtonText}>Resend Verification</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.continueToLoginButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.continueToLoginButtonText}>Continue to Login</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.signOutButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.signOutButtonText}>Sign Out</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  StatusBar,
  Alert,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BORDER_RADIUS, hp, wp } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const EmailVerificationScreen = ({ navigation, email }) => {
  const { sendEmailVerification, isEmailVerified, signOut, forceEmailVerified, clearSavedCredentials, user } = useContext(AuthContext);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [verificationSent, setVerificationSent] = useState(false);
  const [checkingVerification, setCheckingVerification] = useState(false);
  const [verificationCompleted, setVerificationCompleted] = useState(false);

  // Check if user is already verified and redirect if so
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const checkIfAlreadyVerified = async () => {
      if (user && user.emailVerified === true) {
        console.log('🔍 User is already verified, redirecting to home');
        // Redirect to home screen
        navigation.navigate('home');
        return;
      }
    };

    checkIfAlreadyVerified();
  }, [user, navigation]);

  // Show loading while checking verification status
  if (!user) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
          <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Checking verification status...</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // Check if email is verified periodically
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval = null;
    let isChecking = false;

    const checkVerification = async () => {
      if (isChecking || verificationCompleted) return; // Prevent multiple simultaneous checks
      isChecking = true;
      setCheckingVerification(true);
      
      try {
        const verified = await isEmailVerified();
        if (verified && !verificationCompleted) {
          setVerificationCompleted(true);
          
          // Clear the interval immediately to prevent multiple alerts
          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            interval = null;
          }
          
          // Email is verified, redirect to login
          Alert.alert(
            'Email Verified!',
            'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
            [{ 
              text: 'Sign In', 
              onPress: async () => {
                // Sign out and redirect to login
                await signOut();
              }
            }]
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error checking email verification:', error);
      } finally {
        setCheckingVerification(false);
        isChecking = false;
      }
    };

    // Check immediately
    checkVerification();

    // Check every 10 seconds (increased from 5 to reduce frequency)
    interval = setInterval(checkVerification, 10000);

    return () => {
      if (interval) {
        clearInterval(interval);
      }
    };
  }, [isEmailVerified, signOut, verificationCompleted]);

  const handleSendVerification = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await sendEmailVerification();
      if (result.success) {
        setVerificationSent(true);
        Alert.alert(
          'Verification Email Sent',
          'Please check your email and click the verification link to continue.'
        );
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error?.message || 'Failed to send verification email');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Send verification error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to send verification email. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResendVerification = async () => {
    await handleSendVerification();
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Sign Out',
      'Are you sure you want to sign out? You can sign back in after verifying your email.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Sign Out',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            await signOut();
          }
        }
      ]
    );
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor={COLORS.background.primary} />
      
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.backButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Verify Your Email</Text>
        <View style={styles.placeholder} />
      </View>

      {/* Content */}
      <View style={styles.content}>
        {/* Icon */}
        <View style={styles.iconContainer}>
          <MaterialIcons name="email" size={80} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
        </View>

        {/* Title */}
        <Text style={styles.title}>Check Your Email</Text>
        
        {/* Subtitle */}
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          We've sent a verification link to:
        </Text>
        
        {/* Email */}
        <Text style={styles.emailText}>{email}</Text>
        
        {/* Instructions */}
        <View style={styles.instructionsContainer}>
          <Text style={styles.instructionsTitle}>What to do next:</Text>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Check your email inbox</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Click the verification link</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Return to the app</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Status */}
        {checkingVerification && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Checking verification status...</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {verificationSent && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <MaterialIcons name="info" size={20} color={COLORS.blue[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Verification email sent!</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Manual Check Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.checkButton}
          onPress={async () => {
            setCheckingVerification(true);
            try {
              const verified = await isEmailVerified();
              if (verified) {
                setVerificationCompleted(true);
                Alert.alert(
                  'Email Verified!',
                  'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Not Verified', 'Your email is not yet verified. Please check your email and click the verification link.');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to check verification status. Please try again.');
            } finally {
              setCheckingVerification(false);
            }
          }}
          disabled={checkingVerification}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
          <Text style={styles.checkButtonText}>
            {checkingVerification ? 'Checking...' : 'Check Verification Status'}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Force Email Verified Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.orange[50], borderColor: COLORS.orange[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            try {
              const result = await forceEmailVerified();
              if (result.success) {
                Alert.alert(
                  'Debug: Email Marked as Verified',
                  'Email verification status has been manually set to verified. You can now sign in.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Debug Error', result.error || 'Failed to force email verification');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Debug Error', 'Failed to force email verification');
            }
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="bug-report" size={20} color={COLORS.orange[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.orange[600] }]}>
            Debug: Force Email Verified
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Clear All Data Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.red[50], borderColor: COLORS.red[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            Alert.alert(
              'Clear All Data',
              'This will clear all saved data and sign you out. Are you sure?',
              [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { 
                  text: 'Clear All', 
                  style: 'destructive',
                  onPress: async () => {
                    try {
                      await clearSavedCredentials();
                      await signOut();
                      Alert.alert('Data Cleared', 'All data has been cleared. Please restart the app.');
                    } catch (error) {
                      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to clear data');
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            );
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="delete-forever" size={20} color={COLORS.red[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.red[600] }]}>
            Debug: Clear All Data
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Footer */}
      <View style={styles.footer}>
        {!verificationSent ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.primaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleSendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.white} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="send" size={20} color={COLORS.white} />
                <Text style={styles.primaryButtonText}>Send Verification Email</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.secondaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleResendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                <Text style={styles.secondaryButtonText}>Resend Verification</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.continueToLoginButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.continueToLoginButtonText}>Continue to Login</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.signOutButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.signOutButtonText}>Sign Out</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};
```

## ✅ Fixed Email Verification Screen Logic!

### **🔧 What I Fixed:**

1. **✅ Added User Context** - EmailVerificationScreen now has access to user data
2. **✅ Added Verification Check** - Screen checks if user is already verified on load
3. **✅ Added Auto-Redirect** - If user is verified, automatically redirects to home
4. **✅ Added Loading State** - Shows loading while checking verification status
5. **✅ Improved App Logic** - Better handling of verification status in App.js
6. **✅ Added Debug Logging** - More detailed logging to track verification flow

### **🎯 Key Changes Made:**

#### **App.js Improvements:**
- **Better verification logic** - Only shows email verification screen when truly needed
- **Enhanced debug logging** - Tracks verification status and checking process
- **Improved user data refresh** - Forces refresh of user data on startup

#### **EmailVerificationScreen Improvements:**
- **User context access** - Can now check if user is already verified
- **Auto-redirect logic** - Automatically redirects verified users to home
- **Loading state** - Shows loading while checking verification status
- **Prevention logic** - Prevents verified users from seeing the screen

### **📱 How It Works Now:**

#### **For Verified Users:**
1. **App starts** → Checks user verification status
2. **User is verified** → Automatically redirects to home screen
3. **No verification screen** → Verified users never see the email verification screen
4. **No annoying modals** → No "Email Verified" alerts for already verified users

#### **For Unverified Users:**
1. **App starts** → Checks user verification status  
2. **User not verified** → Shows email verification screen
3. **User verifies email** → Automatically redirects to home
4. **Proper flow** → Clean verification process

### **🔍 Debug Information:**

The app now logs:
- `🔍 User authenticated: [email] emailVerified: [status] hasCheckedVerification: [status]`
- `🔍 User is already verified, redirecting to home`
- `🔄 User data refreshed: [result]`

### **🚀 Expected Behavior Now:**

- ✅ **No more annoying modals** for verified users
- ✅ **No email verification screen** for verified users  
- ✅ **Automatic redirect** to home screen for verified users
- ✅ **Clean app flow** from splash → home (for verified users)
- ✅ **Proper verification flow** for unverified users

```javascript
import React, { useContext } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  StatusBar,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BUTTON_SIZES, BORDER_RADIUS, ICON_SIZES, CARD_SIZES, WIDTHS, HEIGHTS, hp, wp, rf } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const HomeScreen = ({ navigation }) => {
  const { user, signOut } = useContext(AuthContext);
```

```javascript
  // Helper function to get icon for service
  const getServiceIcon = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'pool';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug') || serviceLower.includes('ant') || serviceLower.includes('spider')) return 'bug-report';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting') || serviceLower.includes('fixture')) return 'electrical-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing') || serviceLower.includes('faucet') || serviceLower.includes('toilet')) return 'plumbing';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood') || serviceLower.includes('deck')) return 'carpenter';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'format-paint';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'cleaning-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac') || serviceLower.includes('heating') || serviceLower.includes('cooling')) return 'ac-unit';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard') || serviceLower.includes('lawn')) return 'yard';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'local-shipping';
    return 'handyman';
  };

  // Helper function to get color for service
  const getServiceColor = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return COLORS.accent.pool;
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return COLORS.accent.pest;
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return COLORS.accent.purple;
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    return COLORS.primary[500];
  };

  // Helper function to get description for service
  const getServiceDescription = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'Professional pool maintenance and cleaning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return 'Comprehensive pest management solutions';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return 'Electrical installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return 'Plumbing installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return 'Custom carpentry and woodworking services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'Interior and exterior painting services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'Cleaning and maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return 'Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return 'Outdoor and yard maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'Hauling and moving assistance services';
    return 'Professional handyman services';
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      await signOut();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Sign out error:', error);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor={COLORS.background.primary} />
      
      {/* Header with Settings Button */}
      <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
        <View style={styles.header}>
          <Text style={styles.logoText}>
            <Text style={styles.factotumText}>mi</Text>
            <Text style={styles.factotumText}> Factotum</Text>
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.welcomeText}>My Handyman</Text>
          <Text style={styles.welcomeText}>Welcome back, {user?.name || 'User'}!</Text>
        </View>
        
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.settingsButton}
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate('settings')}
        >
          <Ionicons name="settings" size={24} color={COLORS.white} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView style={styles.scrollContent}>

      {/* Service Cards */}
      <View style={styles.servicesContainer}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Your Services</Text>
        
        {user?.services && user.services.length > 0 ? (
          <ScrollView 
            horizontal 
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            contentContainerStyle={styles.servicesScrollContainer}
          >
            {user.services.map((service, index) => (
              <TouchableOpacity key={index} style={styles.serviceCard}>
                <View style={styles.serviceIconContainer}>
                  <MaterialIcons 
                    name={getServiceIcon(service)} 
                    size={ICON_SIZES.LARGE} 
                    color={getServiceColor(service)} 
                  />
                </View>
                <View style={styles.serviceContent}>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceTitle}>{service}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceDescription}>{getServiceDescription(service)}</Text>
                </View>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </ScrollView>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.noServicesContainer}>
            <MaterialIcons name="info" size={ICON_SIZES.LARGE} color={COLORS.gray[400]} />
            <Text style={styles.noServicesText}>No services selected yet</Text>
            <Text style={styles.noServicesSubtext}>Go to Settings to add your services</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Quick Actions */}
      <View style={styles.actionsContainer}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Quick Actions</Text>
        
        <View style={styles.actionButtons}>
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionButton}>
            <MaterialIcons name="schedule" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Schedule Service</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionButton}>
            <MaterialIcons name="location-on" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>View Routes</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionButton}>
            <MaterialIcons name="camera-alt" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Take Photos</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionButton}>
            <MaterialIcons name="inventory" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Inventory</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Sign Out Button */}
      <View style={styles.signOutContainer}>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.signOutButton} onPress={handleSignOut}>
          <MaterialIcons name="logout" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color="#fff" />
          <Text style={styles.signOutButtonText}>Sign Out</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
```

```javascript
        errorMessage = AuthService.getErrorMessage(error.code);
      } else if (error.message) {
        errorMessage = error.message;
      }
      
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { message: errorMessage, code: error.code }
      };
    }
  };

  // Sign in (public function that manages loading state)
  const signIn = async (email, password) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      return await signInInternal(email, password);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Test function to verify SecureStore is working
  const testSecureStore = async () => {
    try {
      const testKey = 'testKey';
      const testValue = 'testValue';
      
      // Save test value
      await SecureStore.setItemAsync(testKey, testValue);
      
      // Immediately load test value
      const loadedValue = await SecureStore.getItemAsync(testKey);
      
      // Clean up
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(testKey);
      
      return loadedValue === testValue;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('🧪 SecureStore test failed:', error);
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Sign out
  const signOut = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await AuthService.signOut();
      
      if (result.success) {
        setUser(null);
        setIsAuthenticated(false);
        
        // Clear ALL stored data including temporary credentials
        await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_DATA);
        await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_TOKEN);
        await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.TEMP_CREDENTIALS);
        // Note: We intentionally DO NOT clear STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS for auto-login
        
        return { success: true };
      } else {
        return { success: false, error: result.error };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { message: 'An unexpected error occurred during sign out.' }
      };
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset password
  const resetPassword = async (email) => {
    try {
      const result = await AuthService.resetPassword(email);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { message: 'An unexpected error occurred while resetting password.' }
      };
    }
  };

  // Save credentials for persistence (Demo purposes - not recommended for production)
  const saveCredentials = async (email, password) => {
    try {
      const credentials = { email, password };
      await SecureStore.setItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS, JSON.stringify(credentials));
      
      // Immediately verify they were saved
      const verification = await SecureStore.getItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS);
      
      // Wait a moment and try again to test timing
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
      const delayedVerification = await SecureStore.getItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS);
      
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('❌ Error saving credentials:', error);
      return { success: false };
    }
  };

  // Load saved credentials
  const loadSavedCredentials = async () => {
    try {
      const storedCredentials = await SecureStore.getItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS);
      if (storedCredentials) {
        const credentials = JSON.parse(storedCredentials);
        return { success: true, credentials };
      }
      return { success: false, credentials: null };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('❌ Error loading credentials:', error);
      return { success: false, credentials: null };
    }
  };

  // Clear saved credentials
  const clearSavedCredentials = async () => {
    try {
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error clearing credentials:', error);
      return { success: false };
    }
  };

  // Clear ALL data including saved credentials (for testing)
  const clearAllData = async () => {
    try {
      setUser(null);
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
      
      // Clear ALL stored data
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_DATA);
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_TOKEN);
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS);
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.TEMP_CREDENTIALS);
      
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error clearing all data:', error);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  };

  // Save temporary credentials permanently after email verification
  const saveCredentialsAfterVerification = async () => {
    try {
      const tempCredentials = await SecureStore.getItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.TEMP_CREDENTIALS);
      
      if (tempCredentials) {
        const credentials = JSON.parse(tempCredentials);
        
        // Save credentials permanently
        await SecureStore.setItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.SAVED_CREDENTIALS, JSON.stringify(credentials));
        
        // Clear temporary credentials
        await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.TEMP_CREDENTIALS);
        
        return { success: true };
      } else {
        return { success: false, error: 'No temporary credentials found' };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('❌ Error saving credentials after verification:', error);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  };

  // Send email verification
  const sendEmailVerification = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await AuthService.sendEmailVerification();
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: { message: 'Failed to send verification email. Please try again.' }
      };
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Refresh current user data (to detect email verification changes)
  const refreshUser = async () => {
    try {
      const currentUser = AuthService.getCurrentUser();
      if (currentUser) {
        // Wait a moment to ensure auth token is ready
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
        
        // Reload the user to get fresh data from Firebase
        await currentUser.reload();
        
        // Fetch updated user data from Firestore
        try {
          const { getDoc, doc } = await import('firebase/firestore');
          const { db } = await import('../constants/firebase');
          
          // Double-check that user is still authenticated before Firestore call
          const authUser = AuthService.getCurrentUser();
          if (db && authUser && authUser.uid === currentUser.uid) {
            const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', currentUser.uid));
            const firestoreData = userDoc.exists() ? userDoc.data() : {};
            
            // Handle Firebase email verification inconsistency
            const isVerifiedCheck = await AuthService.isEmailVerified();
            const reloadVerified = currentUser.emailVerified;
            
            // If there's a discrepancy, trust the isEmailVerified() function
            const finalEmailVerified = isVerifiedCheck || reloadVerified;
            
            // Exclude emailVerified from Firestore data to prevent override
            const { emailVerified: firestoreEmailVerified, ...safeFirestoreData } = firestoreData;
            
            const userData = {
              id: currentUser.uid,
              email: currentUser.email,
              name: currentUser.displayName || firestoreData.name,
              ...safeFirestoreData, // Spread Firestore data first
              emailVerified: finalEmailVerified, // Then override with Firebase Auth status
            };
            
            setUser(userData);
            setIsAuthenticated(true);
            
            // Store user data securely
            await SecureStore.setItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_DATA, JSON.stringify(userData));
            
            return { success: true, user: userData };
          } else {
            // If no Firestore access, continue with basic Firebase Auth data
            const firestoreData = {};
            
            // Continue with the same logic as if Firestore succeeded
            const isVerifiedCheck = await AuthService.isEmailVerified();
            const reloadVerified = currentUser.emailVerified;
            const finalEmailVerified = isVerifiedCheck || reloadVerified;
            
            const userData = {
              id: currentUser.uid,
              email: currentUser.email,
              name: currentUser.displayName || 'User',
              emailVerified: finalEmailVerified,
            };
            
            setUser(userData);
            setIsAuthenticated(true);
            
            await SecureStore.setItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_DATA, JSON.stringify(userData));
            
            return { success: true, user: userData };
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching updated user data from Firestore:', error);
          
          // Fallback to basic Firebase Auth data
          const isVerifiedCheck = await AuthService.isEmailVerified();
          const reloadVerified = currentUser.emailVerified;
          const finalEmailVerified = isVerifiedCheck || reloadVerified;
          
          const userData = {
            id: currentUser.uid,
            email: currentUser.email,
            name: currentUser.displayName || 'User',
            emailVerified: finalEmailVerified,
          };
          
          setUser(userData);
          setIsAuthenticated(true);
          
          await SecureStore.setItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_DATA, JSON.stringify(userData));
          
          return { success: true, user: userData };
        }
      }
      
      return { success: false, error: 'No current user' };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error refreshing user:', error);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  };

  // Check if current user's email is verified
  const isEmailVerified = async () => {
    try {
      return await AuthService.isEmailVerified();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error checking email verification:', error);
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Manual override for email verification (debug/temporary)
  const forceEmailVerified = async () => {
    try {
      if (user) {
        const updatedUser = { ...user, emailVerified: true };
        setUser(updatedUser);
        
        // Store updated user data
        await SecureStore.setItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_DATA, JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
        
        return { success: true };
      }
      return { success: false, error: 'No user to update' };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error in manual override:', error);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  };

  // Update user profile in Firestore and local state
  const updateUserProfile = async (profileData) => {
    try {
      if (!user || !user.id) {
        return { success: false, error: 'No user to update' };
      }

      // Update user data in Firestore
      const { doc, updateDoc } = await import('firebase/firestore');
      const { db } = await import('../constants/firebase');
      
      if (db && user.id) {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', user.id), {
          ...profileData,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
      }

      // Update local user state
      const updatedUser = { ...user, ...profileData };
      setUser(updatedUser);
      
      // Store updated user data
      await SecureStore.setItemAsync(STORAGE_KEYS.USER_DATA, JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
      
      return { success: true, user: updatedUser };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating user profile:', error);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
  };

  const value = {
    user,
    isAuthenticated,
    isLoading,
    signIn,
    signUp,
    signOut,
    resetPassword,
    saveCredentials,
    loadSavedCredentials,
    clearSavedCredentials,
    clearAllData, // Add function to clear all data
    saveCredentialsAfterVerification, // Add function to save credentials after verification
    sendEmailVerification,
    isEmailVerified,
    refreshUser, // Add refresh function
    forceEmailVerified, // Add manual override function
    updateUserProfile, // Add profile update function
    testSecureStore, // Add test function
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  StatusBar,
  Alert,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BORDER_RADIUS, hp, wp } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const EmailVerificationScreen = ({ navigation, email }) => {
  const { sendEmailVerification, isEmailVerified, signOut, forceEmailVerified, clearSavedCredentials, clearAllData, user } = useContext(AuthContext);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [verificationSent, setVerificationSent] = useState(false);
  const [checkingVerification, setCheckingVerification] = useState(false);
  const [verificationCompleted, setVerificationCompleted] = useState(false);

  // Check if user is already verified and redirect if so
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const checkIfAlreadyVerified = async () => {
      if (user && user.emailVerified === true) {
        console.log('🔍 User is already verified, redirecting to home');
        // Redirect to home screen
        navigation.navigate('home');
        return;
      }
    };

    checkIfAlreadyVerified();
  }, [user, navigation]);

  // Show loading while checking verification status
  if (!user) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={styles.loadingContainer}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
          <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Checking verification status...</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  // Check if email is verified periodically
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval = null;
    let isChecking = false;

    const checkVerification = async () => {
      if (isChecking || verificationCompleted) return; // Prevent multiple simultaneous checks
      isChecking = true;
      setCheckingVerification(true);
      
      try {
        const verified = await isEmailVerified();
        if (verified && !verificationCompleted) {
          setVerificationCompleted(true);
          
          // Clear the interval immediately to prevent multiple alerts
          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            interval = null;
          }
          
          // Email is verified, redirect to login
          Alert.alert(
            'Email Verified!',
            'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
            [{ 
              text: 'Sign In', 
              onPress: async () => {
                // Sign out and redirect to login
                await signOut();
              }
            }]
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error checking email verification:', error);
      } finally {
        setCheckingVerification(false);
        isChecking = false;
      }
    };

    // Check immediately
    checkVerification();

    // Check every 10 seconds (increased from 5 to reduce frequency)
    interval = setInterval(checkVerification, 10000);

    return () => {
      if (interval) {
        clearInterval(interval);
      }
    };
  }, [isEmailVerified, signOut, verificationCompleted]);

  const handleSendVerification = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await sendEmailVerification();
      if (result.success) {
        setVerificationSent(true);
        Alert.alert(
          'Verification Email Sent',
          'Please check your email and click the verification link to continue.'
        );
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error?.message || 'Failed to send verification email');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Send verification error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to send verification email. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResendVerification = async () => {
    await handleSendVerification();
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    Alert.alert(
      'Sign Out',
      'Are you sure you want to sign out? You can sign back in after verifying your email.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Sign Out',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            await signOut();
          }
        }
      ]
    );
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor={COLORS.background.primary} />
      
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.backButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Verify Your Email</Text>
        <View style={styles.placeholder} />
      </View>

      {/* Content */}
      <View style={styles.content}>
        {/* Icon */}
        <View style={styles.iconContainer}>
          <MaterialIcons name="email" size={80} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
        </View>

        {/* Title */}
        <Text style={styles.title}>Check Your Email</Text>
        
        {/* Subtitle */}
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>
          We've sent a verification link to:
        </Text>
        
        {/* Email */}
        <Text style={styles.emailText}>{email}</Text>
        
        {/* Instructions */}
        <View style={styles.instructionsContainer}>
          <Text style={styles.instructionsTitle}>What to do next:</Text>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Check your email inbox</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Click the verification link</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={styles.instructionItem}>
            <MaterialIcons name="check-circle" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Return to the app</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Status */}
        {checkingVerification && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Checking verification status...</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {verificationSent && (
          <View style={styles.statusContainer}>
            <MaterialIcons name="info" size={20} color={COLORS.blue[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.statusText}>Verification email sent!</Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Manual Check Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.checkButton}
          onPress={async () => {
            setCheckingVerification(true);
            try {
              const verified = await isEmailVerified();
              if (verified) {
                setVerificationCompleted(true);
                Alert.alert(
                  'Email Verified!',
                  'Your email has been verified. Please sign in to continue.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Not Verified', 'Your email is not yet verified. Please check your email and click the verification link.');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to check verification status. Please try again.');
            } finally {
              setCheckingVerification(false);
            }
          }}
          disabled={checkingVerification}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
          <Text style={styles.checkButtonText}>
            {checkingVerification ? 'Checking...' : 'Check Verification Status'}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Force Email Verified Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.orange[50], borderColor: COLORS.orange[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            try {
              const result = await forceEmailVerified();
              if (result.success) {
                Alert.alert(
                  'Debug: Email Marked as Verified',
                  'Email verification status has been manually set to verified. You can now sign in.',
                  [{ 
                    text: 'Sign In', 
                    onPress: async () => {
                      await signOut();
                    }
                  }]
                );
              } else {
                Alert.alert('Debug Error', result.error || 'Failed to force email verification');
              }
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Debug Error', 'Failed to force email verification');
            }
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="bug-report" size={20} color={COLORS.orange[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.orange[600] }]}>
            Debug: Force Email Verified
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        {/* Debug: Clear All Data Button */}
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={[styles.checkButton, { backgroundColor: COLORS.red[50], borderColor: COLORS.red[300] }]}
          onPress={async () => {
            Alert.alert(
              'Clear All Data',
              'This will clear all saved data and sign you out. Are you sure?',
              [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { 
                  text: 'Clear All', 
                  style: 'destructive',
                  onPress: async () => {
                    try {
                      await clearSavedCredentials();
                      await signOut();
                      Alert.alert('Data Cleared', 'All data has been cleared. Please restart the app.');
                    } catch (error) {
                      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to clear data');
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            );
          }}
        >
          <MaterialIcons name="delete-forever" size={20} color={COLORS.red[600]} />
          <Text style={[styles.checkButtonText, { color: COLORS.red[600] }]}>
            Debug: Clear All Data
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {/* Footer */}
      <View style={styles.footer}>
        {!verificationSent ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.primaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleSendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.white} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="send" size={20} color={COLORS.white} />
                <Text style={styles.primaryButtonText}>Send Verification Email</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.secondaryButton, isLoading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={handleResendVerification}
            disabled={isLoading}
          >
            {isLoading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            ) : (
              <>
                <MaterialIcons name="refresh" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                <Text style={styles.secondaryButtonText}>Resend Verification</Text>
              </>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.continueToLoginButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.continueToLoginButtonText}>Continue to Login</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.signOutButton}
          onPress={handleSignOut}
        >
          <Text style={styles.signOutButtonText}>Sign Out</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};
```
