
Now let me add functions to load customers from Firebase and update the customer management:


```javascript
import React, { useContext, useState } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  StatusBar,
  Alert,
  Modal,
  TextInput,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { CustomerService } from '../services/firebase';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BUTTON_SIZES, BORDER_RADIUS, ICON_SIZES, CARD_SIZES, WIDTHS, HEIGHTS, hp, wp, rf } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const HomeScreen = ({ navigation }) => {
  const { user, signOut } = useContext(AuthContext);
  const [showMenuModal, setShowMenuModal] = useState(false);
  const [showCustomerModal, setShowCustomerModal] = useState(false);
  const [showScheduleServiceModal, setShowScheduleServiceModal] = useState(false);
  const [showScheduleModal, setShowScheduleModal] = useState(false);
  
  // Schedule Service Form State
  const [selectedCustomer, setSelectedCustomer] = useState('');
  const [selectedService, setSelectedService] = useState('');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState('');
  const [selectedTime, setSelectedTime] = useState('');
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState('');
  const [estimatedCost, setEstimatedCost] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  // Customer Form State
  const [customerName, setCustomerName] = useState('');
  const [customerPhone, setCustomerPhone] = useState('');
  const [customerAddress, setCustomerAddress] = useState('');
  const [customerEmail, setCustomerEmail] = useState('');

  // Customer data from Firebase
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [isLoadingCustomers, setIsLoadingCustomers] = useState(false);
  
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState([
    { id: 1, customer: 'John Smith', service: 'Pool Cleaning', date: '2024-01-15', time: '9:00 AM', duration: '2 hours', cost: '$150' },
    { id: 2, customer: 'Sarah Johnson', service: 'Pest Control', date: '2024-01-15', time: '2:00 PM', duration: '1 hour', cost: '$75' },
  ]);
  
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState([
    { id: 1, jobId: 1, customer: 'John Smith', date: '2024-01-10', count: 3 },
    { id: 2, jobId: 2, customer: 'Sarah Johnson', date: '2024-01-12', count: 2 },
  ]);
  
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState([
    { id: 1, name: 'Downtown Route', stops: 3, distance: '12.5 miles' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Suburbs Route', stops: 2, distance: '8.2 miles' },
  ]);

  // Data availability checks
  const hasCustomers = customers.length > 0;
  const hasAppointments = appointments.length > 0;
  const hasPhotos = photos.length > 0;
  const hasRoutes = routes.length > 0;

  // Form validation
  const isScheduleFormValid = () => {
    return selectedCustomer && selectedService && selectedDate && selectedTime && duration;
  };

  const isCustomerFormValid = () => {
    return customerName && customerPhone && customerAddress;
  };

  // Reset form when modal closes
  const resetScheduleForm = () => {
    setSelectedCustomer('');
    setSelectedService('');
    setSelectedDate('');
    setSelectedTime('');
    setDuration('');
    setEstimatedCost('');
    setNotes('');
  };

  const resetCustomerForm = () => {
    setCustomerName('');
    setCustomerPhone('');
    setCustomerAddress('');
    setCustomerEmail('');
  };

  // Load customers from Firebase
  const loadCustomers = async () => {
    setIsLoadingCustomers(true);
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.getCustomers();
      if (result.success) {
        setCustomers(result.customers);
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to load customers:', result.error);
        Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to load customers');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Load customers error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to load customers');
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingCustomers(false);
    }
  };

  // Add customer to Firebase
  const addCustomerToFirebase = async (customerData) => {
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.addCustomer(customerData);
      if (result.success) {
        // Reload customers to get the updated list
        await loadCustomers();
        return true;
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error.message);
        return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Add customer error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to add customer');
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Delete customer from Firebase
  const deleteCustomerFromFirebase = async (customerId) => {
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.deleteCustomer(customerId);
      if (result.success) {
        // Reload customers to get the updated list
        await loadCustomers();
        return true;
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error.message);
        return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Delete customer error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to delete customer');
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Data check handlers
  const handleScheduleServicePress = () => {
    if (!hasCustomers) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Customers Available',
        'You need to add customers before scheduling services. Would you like to add a customer now?',
        [
          { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
          { 
            text: 'Add Customer', 
            onPress: () => setShowCustomerModal(true)
          }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    setShowScheduleServiceModal(true);
  };

  const handleSchedulePress = () => {
    if (!hasAppointments) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Appointments Scheduled',
        'You don\'t have any appointments scheduled yet. Schedule some services to see them here.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    setShowScheduleModal(true);
  };

  const handleTakePhotosPress = () => {
    if (!hasPhotos) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Photos Available',
        'You haven\'t taken any photos yet. Photos are associated with completed jobs.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Photos', 'Photo gallery functionality coming soon!');
  };

  const handleViewRoutesPress = () => {
    if (!hasRoutes) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Routes Available',
        'You don\'t have any routes planned yet. Routes are created when you have multiple appointments in the same area.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Routes', 'Route optimization functionality coming soon!');
  };

  // Helper function to get icon for service
  const getServiceIcon = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'pool';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug') || serviceLower.includes('ant') || serviceLower.includes('spider')) return 'bug-report';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting') || serviceLower.includes('fixture')) return 'electrical-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing') || serviceLower.includes('faucet') || serviceLower.includes('toilet')) return 'plumbing';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood') || serviceLower.includes('deck')) return 'carpenter';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'format-paint';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'cleaning-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac') || serviceLower.includes('heating') || serviceLower.includes('cooling')) return 'ac-unit';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard') || serviceLower.includes('lawn')) return 'yard';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'local-shipping';
    return 'handyman';
  };

  // Helper function to get color for service
  const getServiceColor = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return COLORS.accent.pool;
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return COLORS.accent.pest;
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return COLORS.accent.purple;
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    return COLORS.primary[500];
  };

  // Helper function to get description for service
  const getServiceDescription = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'Professional pool maintenance and cleaning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return 'Comprehensive pest management solutions';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return 'Electrical installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return 'Plumbing installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return 'Custom carpentry and woodworking services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'Interior and exterior painting services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'Cleaning and maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return 'Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return 'Outdoor and yard maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'Hauling and moving assistance services';
    return 'Professional handyman services';
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      await signOut();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Sign out error:', error);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor={COLORS.background.primary} />
      
      {/* Header with Menu and Settings */}
      <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.menuButton}
            onPress={() => {
              console.log('🍔 Hamburger menu pressed');
              setShowMenuModal(true);
            }}
          >
            <Ionicons name="menu" size={24} color={COLORS.white} />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View style={styles.headerContent}>
        <Text style={styles.logoText}>
          <Text style={styles.factotumText}>mi</Text>
          <Text style={styles.factotumText}> Factotum</Text>
        </Text>
        <Text style={styles.welcomeText}>My Handyman</Text>
        <Text style={styles.welcomeText}>Welcome back, {user?.name || 'User'}!</Text>
      </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.settingsButton}
            onPress={() => {
              console.log('🔧 Settings button pressed');
              console.log('🔧 Navigation object:', navigation);
              console.log('🔧 Calling navigation.navigate("settings")');
              navigation.navigate('settings');
              console.log('🔧 Navigation call completed');
            }}
          >
            <Ionicons name="settings" size={24} color={COLORS.white} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      <ScrollView style={styles.scrollContent}>

      {/* Service Cards */}
      <View style={styles.servicesContainer}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Your Services</Text>
        
        {user?.services && user.services.length > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.servicesList}>
            {user.services.map((service, index) => (
              <TouchableOpacity key={index} style={styles.serviceCard}>
          <View style={styles.serviceIconContainer}>
                  <MaterialIcons 
                    name={getServiceIcon(service)} 
                    size={ICON_SIZES.LARGE} 
                    color={getServiceColor(service)} 
                  />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.serviceContent}>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceTitle}>{service}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceDescription}>{getServiceDescription(service)}</Text>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.noServicesContainer}>
            <MaterialIcons name="info" size={ICON_SIZES.LARGE} color={COLORS.gray[400]} />
            <Text style={styles.noServicesText}>No services selected yet</Text>
            <Text style={styles.noServicesSubtext}>Go to Settings to add your services</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Quick Actions */}
      <View style={styles.actionsContainer}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Quick Actions</Text>
        
        <View style={styles.actionButtons}>
          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleScheduleServicePress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="schedule" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Schedule Service</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleSchedulePress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="event" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Schedule</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleViewRoutesPress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="location-on" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>View Routes</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleTakePhotosPress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="camera-alt" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Take Photos</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      </ScrollView>

      {/* Custom Menu Modal with Green Buttons */}
      <Modal
        visible={showMenuModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowMenuModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.modalContent}>
            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>mi Factotum</Text>
            <Text style={styles.modalSubtitle}>Choose an option</Text>
            
            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={styles.modalButton}
              onPress={() => {
                setShowMenuModal(false);
                setShowCustomerModal(true);
              }}
            >
              <Text style={styles.modalButtonText}>Customers</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            
            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={styles.modalButton}
              onPress={() => {
                setShowMenuModal(false);
                handleSignOut();
              }}
            >
              <Text style={styles.modalButtonText}>Sign Out</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            
            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={[styles.modalButton, styles.modalCancelButton]}
              onPress={() => setShowMenuModal(false)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, styles.modalCancelText]}>Cancel</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Customer Management Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showCustomerModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowCustomerModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.bottomModalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.bottomModalContent}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Customers</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                onPress={() => setShowCustomerModal(false)}
                style={styles.closeButton}
              >
                <MaterialIcons name="close" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            
            <View style={styles.searchContainer}>
              <MaterialIcons name="search" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} style={styles.searchIcon} />
              <TextInput
                style={styles.searchInput}
                placeholder="Search customers..."
                placeholderTextColor={COLORS.gray[500]}
              />
            </View>

            <ScrollView style={styles.customerList}>
              {customers.length === 0 ? (
                <View style={styles.emptyState}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="people" size={48} color={COLORS.gray[400]} />
                  <Text style={styles.emptyStateText}>No customers yet</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.emptyStateSubtext}>Add your first customer below</Text>
                </View>
              ) : (
                customers.map((customer) => (
                  <View key={customer.id} style={styles.customerItem}>
                    <View style={styles.customerInfo}>
                      <Text style={styles.customerName}>{customer.name}</Text>
                      <Text style={styles.customerDetails}>{customer.address} • {customer.phone}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View style={styles.customerActions}>
                      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionIcon}>
                        <MaterialIcons name="edit" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                      <TouchableOpacity 
                        style={styles.actionIcon}
                        onPress={() => {
                          Alert.alert(
                            'Delete Customer',
                            `Are you sure you want to delete ${customer.name}?`,
                            [
                              { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                              { 
                                text: 'Delete', 
                                style: 'destructive',
                                onPress: () => {
                                  setCustomers(customers.filter(c => c.id !== customer.id));
                                }
                              }
                            ]
                          );
                        }}
                      >
                        <MaterialIcons name="delete" size={20} color={COLORS.red[500]} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                ))
              )}
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={styles.customerForm}>
              <Text style={styles.formSectionTitle}>Add New Customer</Text>
              
              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Name *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="Customer Name"
                  value={customerName}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerName}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Phone *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="(555) 123-4567"
                  keyboardType="phone-pad"
                  value={customerPhone}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerPhone}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Address *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.textInput, styles.textArea]}
                  placeholder="123 Main St, City, State 12345"
                  multiline
                  numberOfLines={2}
                  value={customerAddress}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerAddress}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Email (optional)</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="customer@email.com"
                  keyboardType="email-address"
                  value={customerEmail}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerEmail}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={[
                styles.addButton,
                !isCustomerFormValid() && styles.disabledButton
              ]}
              onPress={() => {
                if (isCustomerFormValid()) {
                  const newCustomer = {
                    id: customers.length + 1,
                    name: customerName,
                    phone: customerPhone,
                    address: customerAddress,
                    email: customerEmail || 'No email provided'
                  };
                  setCustomers([...customers, newCustomer]);
                  Alert.alert('Success', 'Customer added successfully!');
                  resetCustomerForm();
                }
              }}
              disabled={!isCustomerFormValid()}
            >
              <MaterialIcons name="add" size={24} color={COLORS.white} />
              <Text style={[
                styles.addButtonText,
                !isCustomerFormValid() && styles.disabledButtonText
              ]}>
                Add Customer
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Schedule Service Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showScheduleServiceModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowScheduleServiceModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.bottomModalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.bottomModalContent}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Schedule Service</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                onPress={() => setShowScheduleServiceModal(false)}
                style={styles.closeButton}
              >
                <MaterialIcons name="close" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            
            <ScrollView style={styles.scheduleForm}>
              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Customer *</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.customerSelector}>
                  <Text style={[styles.customerSelectorText, selectedCustomer && styles.selectedText]}>
                    {selectedCustomer || 'Select Customer'}
                  </Text>
                  <MaterialIcons name="arrow-drop-down" size={24} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Service Type *</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.serviceSelector}>
                  <Text style={[styles.serviceSelectorText, selectedService && styles.selectedText]}>
                    {selectedService || 'Select Service'}
                  </Text>
                  <MaterialIcons name="arrow-drop-down" size={24} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formRow}>
                <View style={styles.formGroupHalf}>
                  <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Date *</Text>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={styles.dateSelector}>
                    <MaterialIcons name="calendar-today" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                    <Text style={[styles.dateSelectorText, selectedDate && styles.selectedText]}>
                      {selectedDate || 'Select Date'}
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.formGroupHalf}>
                  <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Time *</Text>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={styles.timeSelector}>
                    <MaterialIcons name="access-time" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                    <Text style={[styles.timeSelectorText, selectedTime && styles.selectedText]}>
                      {selectedTime || 'Select Time'}
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Expected Duration (hours) *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="2"
                  keyboardType="numeric"
                  value={duration}
                  onChangeText={setDuration}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Estimated Cost (optional)</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="$150"
                  keyboardType="numeric"
                  value={estimatedCost}
                  onChangeText={setEstimatedCost}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Notes</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.textInput, styles.textArea]}
                  placeholder="Additional notes..."
                  multiline
                  numberOfLines={3}
                  value={notes}
                  onChangeText={setNotes}
                />
              </View>
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={styles.modalActions}>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                style={[styles.modalButton, styles.cancelButton]}
                onPress={() => {
                  resetScheduleForm();
                  setShowScheduleServiceModal(false);
                }}
              >
                <Text style={styles.cancelButtonText}>Cancel</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                style={[
                  styles.modalButton, 
                  styles.confirmButton,
                  !isScheduleFormValid() && styles.disabledButton
                ]}
                onPress={() => {
                  if (isScheduleFormValid()) {
                    Alert.alert('Success', 'Service scheduled successfully!');
                    resetScheduleForm();
                    setShowScheduleServiceModal(false);
                  }
                }}
                disabled={!isScheduleFormValid()}
              >
                <Text style={[
                  styles.confirmButtonText,
                  !isScheduleFormValid() && styles.disabledButtonText
                ]}>
                  Schedule Service
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Schedule List Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showScheduleModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowScheduleModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.bottomModalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.bottomModalContent}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Schedule</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                onPress={() => setShowScheduleModal(false)}
                style={styles.closeButton}
              >
                <MaterialIcons name="close" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            
            <View style={styles.filterContainer}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Day</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Week</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Month</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <ScrollView style={styles.scheduleList}>
              {/* Sample schedule data */}
              <View style={styles.scheduleItem}>
                <View style={styles.scheduleTime}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTimeText}>9:00 AM</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.scheduleDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTitle}>Pool Cleaning - John Smith</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleLocation}>123 Main St</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleDuration}>2 hours • $150</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.scheduleAction}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="more-vert" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.scheduleItem}>
                <View style={styles.scheduleTime}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTimeText}>2:00 PM</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.scheduleDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTitle}>Pest Control - Sarah Johnson</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleLocation}>456 Oak Ave</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleDuration}>1 hour • $75</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.scheduleAction}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="more-vert" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
};
```

Now let me add a useEffect to load customers when the component mounts:


```javascript
import React, { useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  StatusBar,
  Alert,
  Modal,
  TextInput,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { CustomerService } from '../services/firebase';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BUTTON_SIZES, BORDER_RADIUS, ICON_SIZES, CARD_SIZES, WIDTHS, HEIGHTS, hp, wp, rf } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const HomeScreen = ({ navigation }) => {
  const { user, signOut } = useContext(AuthContext);
  const [showMenuModal, setShowMenuModal] = useState(false);
  const [showCustomerModal, setShowCustomerModal] = useState(false);
  const [showScheduleServiceModal, setShowScheduleServiceModal] = useState(false);
  const [showScheduleModal, setShowScheduleModal] = useState(false);
  
  // Schedule Service Form State
  const [selectedCustomer, setSelectedCustomer] = useState('');
  const [selectedService, setSelectedService] = useState('');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState('');
  const [selectedTime, setSelectedTime] = useState('');
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState('');
  const [estimatedCost, setEstimatedCost] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  // Customer Form State
  const [customerName, setCustomerName] = useState('');
  const [customerPhone, setCustomerPhone] = useState('');
  const [customerAddress, setCustomerAddress] = useState('');
  const [customerEmail, setCustomerEmail] = useState('');

  // Customer data from Firebase
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [isLoadingCustomers, setIsLoadingCustomers] = useState(false);
  
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState([
    { id: 1, customer: 'John Smith', service: 'Pool Cleaning', date: '2024-01-15', time: '9:00 AM', duration: '2 hours', cost: '$150' },
    { id: 2, customer: 'Sarah Johnson', service: 'Pest Control', date: '2024-01-15', time: '2:00 PM', duration: '1 hour', cost: '$75' },
  ]);
  
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState([
    { id: 1, jobId: 1, customer: 'John Smith', date: '2024-01-10', count: 3 },
    { id: 2, jobId: 2, customer: 'Sarah Johnson', date: '2024-01-12', count: 2 },
  ]);
  
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState([
    { id: 1, name: 'Downtown Route', stops: 3, distance: '12.5 miles' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Suburbs Route', stops: 2, distance: '8.2 miles' },
  ]);

  // Data availability checks
  const hasCustomers = customers.length > 0;
  const hasAppointments = appointments.length > 0;
  const hasPhotos = photos.length > 0;
  const hasRoutes = routes.length > 0;

  // Form validation
  const isScheduleFormValid = () => {
    return selectedCustomer && selectedService && selectedDate && selectedTime && duration;
  };

  const isCustomerFormValid = () => {
    return customerName && customerPhone && customerAddress;
  };

  // Reset form when modal closes
  const resetScheduleForm = () => {
    setSelectedCustomer('');
    setSelectedService('');
    setSelectedDate('');
    setSelectedTime('');
    setDuration('');
    setEstimatedCost('');
    setNotes('');
  };

  const resetCustomerForm = () => {
    setCustomerName('');
    setCustomerPhone('');
    setCustomerAddress('');
    setCustomerEmail('');
  };

  // Load customers from Firebase
  const loadCustomers = async () => {
    setIsLoadingCustomers(true);
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.getCustomers();
      if (result.success) {
        setCustomers(result.customers);
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to load customers:', result.error);
        Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to load customers');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Load customers error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to load customers');
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingCustomers(false);
    }
  };

  // Add customer to Firebase
  const addCustomerToFirebase = async (customerData) => {
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.addCustomer(customerData);
      if (result.success) {
        // Reload customers to get the updated list
        await loadCustomers();
        return true;
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error.message);
        return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Add customer error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to add customer');
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Delete customer from Firebase
  const deleteCustomerFromFirebase = async (customerId) => {
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.deleteCustomer(customerId);
      if (result.success) {
        // Reload customers to get the updated list
        await loadCustomers();
        return true;
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error.message);
        return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Delete customer error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to delete customer');
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Data check handlers
  const handleScheduleServicePress = () => {
    if (!hasCustomers) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Customers Available',
        'You need to add customers before scheduling services. Would you like to add a customer now?',
        [
          { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
          { 
            text: 'Add Customer', 
            onPress: () => setShowCustomerModal(true)
          }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    setShowScheduleServiceModal(true);
  };

  const handleSchedulePress = () => {
    if (!hasAppointments) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Appointments Scheduled',
        'You don\'t have any appointments scheduled yet. Schedule some services to see them here.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    setShowScheduleModal(true);
  };

  const handleTakePhotosPress = () => {
    if (!hasPhotos) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Photos Available',
        'You haven\'t taken any photos yet. Photos are associated with completed jobs.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Photos', 'Photo gallery functionality coming soon!');
  };

  const handleViewRoutesPress = () => {
    if (!hasRoutes) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Routes Available',
        'You don\'t have any routes planned yet. Routes are created when you have multiple appointments in the same area.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Routes', 'Route optimization functionality coming soon!');
  };

  // Helper function to get icon for service
  const getServiceIcon = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'pool';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug') || serviceLower.includes('ant') || serviceLower.includes('spider')) return 'bug-report';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting') || serviceLower.includes('fixture')) return 'electrical-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing') || serviceLower.includes('faucet') || serviceLower.includes('toilet')) return 'plumbing';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood') || serviceLower.includes('deck')) return 'carpenter';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'format-paint';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'cleaning-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac') || serviceLower.includes('heating') || serviceLower.includes('cooling')) return 'ac-unit';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard') || serviceLower.includes('lawn')) return 'yard';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'local-shipping';
    return 'handyman';
  };

  // Helper function to get color for service
  const getServiceColor = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return COLORS.accent.pool;
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return COLORS.accent.pest;
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return COLORS.accent.purple;
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    return COLORS.primary[500];
  };

  // Helper function to get description for service
  const getServiceDescription = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'Professional pool maintenance and cleaning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return 'Comprehensive pest management solutions';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return 'Electrical installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return 'Plumbing installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return 'Custom carpentry and woodworking services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'Interior and exterior painting services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'Cleaning and maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return 'Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return 'Outdoor and yard maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'Hauling and moving assistance services';
    return 'Professional handyman services';
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      await signOut();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Sign out error:', error);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>

      {/* Header with Menu and Settings */}

          <View style={styles.headerContent}>
        <Text style={styles.logoText}>

      </View>

          <TouchableOpacity

          >

          <View style={styles.serviceIconContainer}>

                    name={getServiceIcon(service)}

          </View>
          <View style={styles.serviceContent}>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceTitle}>{service}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceDescription}>{getServiceDescription(service)}</Text>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>
        ) : (

              <TouchableOpacity

                ]}

                    setShowScheduleServiceModal(false);
                  }
                }}
                disabled={!isScheduleFormValid()}
              >
                <Text style={[
                  styles.confirmButtonText,
                  !isScheduleFormValid() && styles.disabledButtonText
                ]}>
                  Schedule Service
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Schedule List Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showScheduleModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowScheduleModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.bottomModalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.bottomModalContent}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Schedule</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                onPress={() => setShowScheduleModal(false)}
                style={styles.closeButton}
              >
                <MaterialIcons name="close" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            
            <View style={styles.filterContainer}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Day</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Week</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Month</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <ScrollView style={styles.scheduleList}>
              {/* Sample schedule data */}
              <View style={styles.scheduleItem}>
                <View style={styles.scheduleTime}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTimeText}>9:00 AM</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.scheduleDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTitle}>Pool Cleaning - John Smith</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleLocation}>123 Main St</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleDuration}>2 hours • $150</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.scheduleAction}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="more-vert" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.scheduleItem}>
                <View style={styles.scheduleTime}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTimeText}>2:00 PM</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.scheduleDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTitle}>Pest Control - Sarah Johnson</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleLocation}>456 Oak Ave</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleDuration}>1 hour • $75</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.scheduleAction}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="more-vert" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
};
```

```javascript
import React, { useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  StatusBar,
  Alert,
  Modal,
  TextInput,
} from 'react-native';
import { MaterialIcons, Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { COLORS } from '../constants/colors';
import { AuthContext } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { CustomerService } from '../services/firebase';
import { FONT_SIZES, SPACING, BUTTON_SIZES, BORDER_RADIUS, ICON_SIZES, CARD_SIZES, WIDTHS, HEIGHTS, hp, wp, rf } from '../constants/responsiveSizes';

const HomeScreen = ({ navigation }) => {
  const { user, signOut } = useContext(AuthContext);
  const [showMenuModal, setShowMenuModal] = useState(false);
  const [showCustomerModal, setShowCustomerModal] = useState(false);
  const [showScheduleServiceModal, setShowScheduleServiceModal] = useState(false);
  const [showScheduleModal, setShowScheduleModal] = useState(false);
  
  // Schedule Service Form State
  const [selectedCustomer, setSelectedCustomer] = useState('');
  const [selectedService, setSelectedService] = useState('');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState('');
  const [selectedTime, setSelectedTime] = useState('');
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState('');
  const [estimatedCost, setEstimatedCost] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  // Customer Form State
  const [customerName, setCustomerName] = useState('');
  const [customerPhone, setCustomerPhone] = useState('');
  const [customerAddress, setCustomerAddress] = useState('');
  const [customerEmail, setCustomerEmail] = useState('');

  // Customer data from Firebase
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [isLoadingCustomers, setIsLoadingCustomers] = useState(false);
  
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState([
    { id: 1, customer: 'John Smith', service: 'Pool Cleaning', date: '2024-01-15', time: '9:00 AM', duration: '2 hours', cost: '$150' },
    { id: 2, customer: 'Sarah Johnson', service: 'Pest Control', date: '2024-01-15', time: '2:00 PM', duration: '1 hour', cost: '$75' },
  ]);
  
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState([
    { id: 1, jobId: 1, customer: 'John Smith', date: '2024-01-10', count: 3 },
    { id: 2, jobId: 2, customer: 'Sarah Johnson', date: '2024-01-12', count: 2 },
  ]);
  
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState([
    { id: 1, name: 'Downtown Route', stops: 3, distance: '12.5 miles' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Suburbs Route', stops: 2, distance: '8.2 miles' },
  ]);

  // Load customers when component mounts
  useEffect(() => {
    loadCustomers();
  }, []);

  // Data availability checks
  const hasCustomers = customers.length > 0;
  const hasAppointments = appointments.length > 0;
  const hasPhotos = photos.length > 0;
  const hasRoutes = routes.length > 0;

  // Form validation
  const isScheduleFormValid = () => {
    return selectedCustomer && selectedService && selectedDate && selectedTime && duration;
  };

  const isCustomerFormValid = () => {
    return customerName && customerPhone && customerAddress;
  };

  // Reset form when modal closes
  const resetScheduleForm = () => {
    setSelectedCustomer('');
    setSelectedService('');
    setSelectedDate('');
    setSelectedTime('');
    setDuration('');
    setEstimatedCost('');
    setNotes('');
  };

  const resetCustomerForm = () => {
    setCustomerName('');
    setCustomerPhone('');
    setCustomerAddress('');
    setCustomerEmail('');
  };

  // Load customers from Firebase
  const loadCustomers = async () => {
    setIsLoadingCustomers(true);
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.getCustomers();
      if (result.success) {
        setCustomers(result.customers);
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to load customers:', result.error);
        Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to load customers');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Load customers error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to load customers');
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingCustomers(false);
    }
  };

  // Add customer to Firebase
  const addCustomerToFirebase = async (customerData) => {
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.addCustomer(customerData);
      if (result.success) {
        // Reload customers to get the updated list
        await loadCustomers();
        return true;
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error.message);
        return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Add customer error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to add customer');
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Delete customer from Firebase
  const deleteCustomerFromFirebase = async (customerId) => {
    try {
      const result = await CustomerService.deleteCustomer(customerId);
      if (result.success) {
        // Reload customers to get the updated list
        await loadCustomers();
        return true;
      } else {
        Alert.alert('Error', result.error.message);
        return false;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Delete customer error:', error);
      Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to delete customer');
      return false;
    }
  };

  // Data check handlers
  const handleScheduleServicePress = () => {
    if (!hasCustomers) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Customers Available',
        'You need to add customers before scheduling services. Would you like to add a customer now?',
        [
          { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
          { 
            text: 'Add Customer', 
            onPress: () => setShowCustomerModal(true)
          }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    setShowScheduleServiceModal(true);
  };

  const handleSchedulePress = () => {
    if (!hasAppointments) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Appointments Scheduled',
        'You don\'t have any appointments scheduled yet. Schedule some services to see them here.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    setShowScheduleModal(true);
  };

  const handleTakePhotosPress = () => {
    if (!hasPhotos) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Photos Available',
        'You haven\'t taken any photos yet. Photos are associated with completed jobs.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Photos', 'Photo gallery functionality coming soon!');
  };

  const handleViewRoutesPress = () => {
    if (!hasRoutes) {
      Alert.alert(
        'No Routes Available',
        'You don\'t have any routes planned yet. Routes are created when you have multiple appointments in the same area.',
        [
          { text: 'OK', style: 'default' }
        ]
      );
      return;
    }
    Alert.alert('Routes', 'Route optimization functionality coming soon!');
  };

  // Helper function to get icon for service
  const getServiceIcon = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'pool';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug') || serviceLower.includes('ant') || serviceLower.includes('spider')) return 'bug-report';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting') || serviceLower.includes('fixture')) return 'electrical-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing') || serviceLower.includes('faucet') || serviceLower.includes('toilet')) return 'plumbing';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood') || serviceLower.includes('deck')) return 'carpenter';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'format-paint';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'cleaning-services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac') || serviceLower.includes('heating') || serviceLower.includes('cooling')) return 'ac-unit';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard') || serviceLower.includes('lawn')) return 'yard';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'local-shipping';
    return 'handyman';
  };

  // Helper function to get color for service
  const getServiceColor = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return COLORS.accent.pool;
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return COLORS.accent.pest;
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return COLORS.accent.purple;
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return COLORS.accent.blue;
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return COLORS.accent.green;
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return COLORS.accent.orange;
    return COLORS.primary[500];
  };

  // Helper function to get description for service
  const getServiceDescription = (service) => {
    const serviceLower = service.toLowerCase();
    if (serviceLower.includes('pool') || serviceLower.includes('spa')) return 'Professional pool maintenance and cleaning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('pest') || serviceLower.includes('bug')) return 'Comprehensive pest management solutions';
    if (serviceLower.includes('electrical') || serviceLower.includes('lighting')) return 'Electrical installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('plumbing')) return 'Plumbing installation and repair services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('carpentry') || serviceLower.includes('wood')) return 'Custom carpentry and woodworking services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('painting') || serviceLower.includes('paint')) return 'Interior and exterior painting services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('cleaning') || serviceLower.includes('maintenance')) return 'Cleaning and maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hvac')) return 'Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('outdoor') || serviceLower.includes('yard')) return 'Outdoor and yard maintenance services';
    if (serviceLower.includes('hauling') || serviceLower.includes('moving')) return 'Hauling and moving assistance services';
    return 'Professional handyman services';
  };

  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      await signOut();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Sign out error:', error);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <StatusBar barStyle="dark-content" backgroundColor={COLORS.background.primary} />
      
      {/* Header with Menu and Settings */}
      <View style={styles.headerContainer}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.menuButton}
            onPress={() => {
              console.log('🍔 Hamburger menu pressed');
              setShowMenuModal(true);
            }}
          >
            <Ionicons name="menu" size={24} color={COLORS.white} />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <View style={styles.headerContent}>
        <Text style={styles.logoText}>
          <Text style={styles.factotumText}>mi</Text>
          <Text style={styles.factotumText}> Factotum</Text>
        </Text>
        <Text style={styles.welcomeText}>My Handyman</Text>
        <Text style={styles.welcomeText}>Welcome back, {user?.name || 'User'}!</Text>
      </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.settingsButton}
            onPress={() => {
              console.log('🔧 Settings button pressed');
              console.log('🔧 Navigation object:', navigation);
              console.log('🔧 Calling navigation.navigate("settings")');
              navigation.navigate('settings');
              console.log('🔧 Navigation call completed');
            }}
          >
            <Ionicons name="settings" size={24} color={COLORS.white} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      <ScrollView style={styles.scrollContent}>

      {/* Service Cards */}
      <View style={styles.servicesContainer}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Your Services</Text>
        
        {user?.services && user.services.length > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.servicesList}>
            {user.services.map((service, index) => (
              <TouchableOpacity key={index} style={styles.serviceCard}>
          <View style={styles.serviceIconContainer}>
                  <MaterialIcons 
                    name={getServiceIcon(service)} 
                    size={ICON_SIZES.LARGE} 
                    color={getServiceColor(service)} 
                  />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.serviceContent}>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceTitle}>{service}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.serviceDescription}>{getServiceDescription(service)}</Text>
          </View>
        </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.noServicesContainer}>
            <MaterialIcons name="info" size={ICON_SIZES.LARGE} color={COLORS.gray[400]} />
            <Text style={styles.noServicesText}>No services selected yet</Text>
            <Text style={styles.noServicesSubtext}>Go to Settings to add your services</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Quick Actions */}
      <View style={styles.actionsContainer}>
        <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Quick Actions</Text>
        
        <View style={styles.actionButtons}>
          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleScheduleServicePress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="schedule" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Schedule Service</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleSchedulePress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="event" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Schedule</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleViewRoutesPress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="location-on" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>View Routes</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity 
            style={styles.actionButton}
            onPress={handleTakePhotosPress}
          >
            <MaterialIcons name="camera-alt" size={ICON_SIZES.MEDIUM} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
            <Text style={styles.actionButtonText}>Take Photos</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      </ScrollView>

      {/* Custom Menu Modal with Green Buttons */}
      <Modal
        visible={showMenuModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowMenuModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.modalContent}>
            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>mi Factotum</Text>
            <Text style={styles.modalSubtitle}>Choose an option</Text>
            
            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={styles.modalButton}
              onPress={() => {
                setShowMenuModal(false);
                setShowCustomerModal(true);
              }}
            >
              <Text style={styles.modalButtonText}>Customers</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            
            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={styles.modalButton}
              onPress={() => {
                setShowMenuModal(false);
                handleSignOut();
              }}
            >
              <Text style={styles.modalButtonText}>Sign Out</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
            
            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={[styles.modalButton, styles.modalCancelButton]}
              onPress={() => setShowMenuModal(false)}
            >
              <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, styles.modalCancelText]}>Cancel</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Customer Management Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showCustomerModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowCustomerModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.bottomModalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.bottomModalContent}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Customers</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                onPress={() => setShowCustomerModal(false)}
                style={styles.closeButton}
              >
                <MaterialIcons name="close" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            
            <View style={styles.searchContainer}>
              <MaterialIcons name="search" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} style={styles.searchIcon} />
              <TextInput
                style={styles.searchInput}
                placeholder="Search customers..."
                placeholderTextColor={COLORS.gray[500]}
              />
            </View>

            <ScrollView style={styles.customerList}>
              {customers.length === 0 ? (
                <View style={styles.emptyState}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="people" size={48} color={COLORS.gray[400]} />
                  <Text style={styles.emptyStateText}>No customers yet</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.emptyStateSubtext}>Add your first customer below</Text>
                </View>
              ) : (
                customers.map((customer) => (
                  <View key={customer.id} style={styles.customerItem}>
                    <View style={styles.customerInfo}>
                      <Text style={styles.customerName}>{customer.name}</Text>
                      <Text style={styles.customerDetails}>{customer.address} • {customer.phone}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View style={styles.customerActions}>
                      <TouchableOpacity style={styles.actionIcon}>
                        <MaterialIcons name="edit" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                      <TouchableOpacity 
                        style={styles.actionIcon}
                        onPress={() => {
                          Alert.alert(
                            'Delete Customer',
                            `Are you sure you want to delete ${customer.name}?`,
                            [
                              { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                              { 
                                text: 'Delete', 
                                style: 'destructive',
                                onPress: () => {
                                  setCustomers(customers.filter(c => c.id !== customer.id));
                                }
                              }
                            ]
                          );
                        }}
                      >
                        <MaterialIcons name="delete" size={20} color={COLORS.red[500]} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                ))
              )}
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={styles.customerForm}>
              <Text style={styles.formSectionTitle}>Add New Customer</Text>
              
              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Name *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="Customer Name"
                  value={customerName}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerName}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Phone *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="(555) 123-4567"
                  keyboardType="phone-pad"
                  value={customerPhone}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerPhone}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Address *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.textInput, styles.textArea]}
                  placeholder="123 Main St, City, State 12345"
                  multiline
                  numberOfLines={2}
                  value={customerAddress}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerAddress}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Email (optional)</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="customer@email.com"
                  keyboardType="email-address"
                  value={customerEmail}
                  onChangeText={setCustomerEmail}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity 
              style={[
                styles.addButton,
                !isCustomerFormValid() && styles.disabledButton
              ]}
              onPress={() => {
                if (isCustomerFormValid()) {
                  const newCustomer = {
                    id: customers.length + 1,
                    name: customerName,
                    phone: customerPhone,
                    address: customerAddress,
                    email: customerEmail || 'No email provided'
                  };
                  setCustomers([...customers, newCustomer]);
                  Alert.alert('Success', 'Customer added successfully!');
                  resetCustomerForm();
                }
              }}
              disabled={!isCustomerFormValid()}
            >
              <MaterialIcons name="add" size={24} color={COLORS.white} />
              <Text style={[
                styles.addButtonText,
                !isCustomerFormValid() && styles.disabledButtonText
              ]}>
                Add Customer
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Schedule Service Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showScheduleServiceModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowScheduleServiceModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.bottomModalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.bottomModalContent}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Schedule Service</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                onPress={() => setShowScheduleServiceModal(false)}
                style={styles.closeButton}
              >
                <MaterialIcons name="close" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            
            <ScrollView style={styles.scheduleForm}>
              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Customer *</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.customerSelector}>
                  <Text style={[styles.customerSelectorText, selectedCustomer && styles.selectedText]}>
                    {selectedCustomer || 'Select Customer'}
                  </Text>
                  <MaterialIcons name="arrow-drop-down" size={24} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Service Type *</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.serviceSelector}>
                  <Text style={[styles.serviceSelectorText, selectedService && styles.selectedText]}>
                    {selectedService || 'Select Service'}
                  </Text>
                  <MaterialIcons name="arrow-drop-down" size={24} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formRow}>
                <View style={styles.formGroupHalf}>
                  <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Date *</Text>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={styles.dateSelector}>
                    <MaterialIcons name="calendar-today" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                    <Text style={[styles.dateSelectorText, selectedDate && styles.selectedText]}>
                      {selectedDate || 'Select Date'}
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.formGroupHalf}>
                  <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Time *</Text>
                  <TouchableOpacity style={styles.timeSelector}>
                    <MaterialIcons name="access-time" size={20} color={COLORS.primary[500]} />
                    <Text style={[styles.timeSelectorText, selectedTime && styles.selectedText]}>
                      {selectedTime || 'Select Time'}
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Expected Duration (hours) *</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="2"
                  keyboardType="numeric"
                  value={duration}
                  onChangeText={setDuration}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Estimated Cost (optional)</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.textInput}
                  placeholder="$150"
                  keyboardType="numeric"
                  value={estimatedCost}
                  onChangeText={setEstimatedCost}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.formGroup}>
                <Text style={styles.formLabel}>Notes</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.textInput, styles.textArea]}
                  placeholder="Additional notes..."
                  multiline
                  numberOfLines={3}
                  value={notes}
                  onChangeText={setNotes}
                />
              </View>
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={styles.modalActions}>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                style={[styles.modalButton, styles.cancelButton]}
                onPress={() => {
                  resetScheduleForm();
                  setShowScheduleServiceModal(false);
                }}
              >
                <Text style={styles.cancelButtonText}>Cancel</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                style={[
                  styles.modalButton, 
                  styles.confirmButton,
                  !isScheduleFormValid() && styles.disabledButton
                ]}
                onPress={() => {
                  if (isScheduleFormValid()) {
                    Alert.alert('Success', 'Service scheduled successfully!');
                    resetScheduleForm();
                    setShowScheduleServiceModal(false);
                  }
                }}
                disabled={!isScheduleFormValid()}
              >
                <Text style={[
                  styles.confirmButtonText,
                  !isScheduleFormValid() && styles.disabledButtonText
                ]}>
                  Schedule Service
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Schedule List Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showScheduleModal}
        transparent={true}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowScheduleModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.bottomModalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.bottomModalContent}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Schedule</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity 
                onPress={() => setShowScheduleModal(false)}
                style={styles.closeButton}
              >
                <MaterialIcons name="close" size={24} color={COLORS.text.primary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            
            <View style={styles.filterContainer}>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Day</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Week</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity style={styles.filterButton}>
                <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>Month</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <ScrollView style={styles.scheduleList}>
              {/* Sample schedule data */}
              <View style={styles.scheduleItem}>
                <View style={styles.scheduleTime}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTimeText}>9:00 AM</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.scheduleDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTitle}>Pool Cleaning - John Smith</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleLocation}>123 Main St</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleDuration}>2 hours • $150</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.scheduleAction}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="more-vert" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.scheduleItem}>
                <View style={styles.scheduleTime}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTimeText}>2:00 PM</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.scheduleDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleTitle}>Pest Control - Sarah Johnson</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleLocation}>456 Oak Ave</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.scheduleDuration}>1 hour • $75</Text>
                </View>
                <TouchableOpacity style={styles.scheduleAction}>
                  <MaterialIcons name="more-vert" size={20} color={COLORS.gray[500]} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>
    </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
};
```
